get.description:
Returns the KYB summary for a business: the KYB profile, or `null` if the business has not yet submitted one.

Use this as your primary read endpoint before starting the onboarding flow to check what data is already on file.

**Required role:** `admin` or `operator`.

put.description:
Save or update the registered (legal) address for a business. This address is forwarded to Noah as `LegalAddress` during the KYB prefill. Safe to call multiple times — it's an upsert.

`country` must be a 2-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. `KE`, `NG`, `ZA`).

**Required role:** `admin` or `operator`.

get.description:
Returns active KYB documents stored in Cloudflare R2 for this business. Use ``provider_document_type`` when submitting to the aggregator international_ramp KYB API.

**Required role:** `admin` or `operator`.

post.description:
Accept a multipart file from the dashboard and upload it to the partner customer vault as ``content_base64`` (``POST /partner/customers/{id}/documents``). A local document row is recorded for checklist/resume. R2 is optional and not required.

**Multipart form fields:**
- `file` — PDF, JPEG, or PNG (max 10 MB)
- `document_type` — vault category / snake_case type, e.g. `certificate_of_incorporation`, `identity`
- `issuing_country` — optional ISO alpha-2 or alpha-3 (required for ID docs)
- `associate_ref_id` — optional associate UUID for shareholder documents

**Required role:** `admin` or `operator`.

delete.description:
Soft-deletes the document record and removes the object from R2.

**Required role:** `admin` or `operator`.

get.summary: View or download a submitted KYB document
get.description:
Streams document bytes from Mboka's local R2 cache (written at upload). The partner vault does not expose partner download APIs.

**Required role:** `admin` or `operator`.

post.summary: Submit uploaded KYB document to verifier
post.description:
After ``POST …/kyb/documents``, call this with ``{ "doc_id": <id> }``. For vault uploads this is idempotent (document was already sent as base64). Legacy R2-staged rows are still uploaded here.

**Required role:** `admin` or `operator`.

Starts business KYB verification.

**Default (`provider` omitted or `international_ramp`):** document upload flow. Enrolls the business on the aggregator, returns `document_requirements` (which files to collect) and `next_steps` (ordered API calls). Use `GET …/kyb/document-requirements` anytime to refresh the checklist.

**`provider=noah`:** legacy Noah hosted redirect — response includes `hosted_url`.

**Before calling:**
1. `POST …/kyb/profile` (include `registration_number` before initiate)
2. `PUT …/kyb/address`
3. Associates on profile (required for international_ramp initiate)

**Required role:** `admin` or `operator`.

post.description:
Create the KYB profile for a business. Returns `409` if a profile already exists — use `PATCH /{business_id}/kyb/profile` to update it.

All fields are optional at creation time, but providing as much data as possible improves the Noah prefill quality.

**Enum values:**
- `business_type`: `SoleTrader` | `LimitedCompany` | `LimitedLiabilityCompany` | `Partnership` | `NonProfit` | `Other`
- `estimated_employees`: `1-10` | `11-50` | `51-200` | `201-1000` | `1000+`
- `annual_revenue_range`: `LessThan100k` | `100kTo1M` | `1MTo10M` | `MoreThan10M`
- `source_of_funds`: `Revenue` | `Investment` | `Loans` | `Grants` | `Other`

**Required role:** `admin` or `operator`.

patch.description:
Partially update the KYB profile for a business. Send only the fields you want to change — omitted fields are left unchanged.

Returns `404` if no profile exists yet — use `POST /{business_id}/kyb/profile` to create one.

**Enum values** (only include fields you are changing):
- `business_type`: `SoleTrader` | `LimitedCompany` | `LimitedLiabilityCompany` | `Partnership` | `NonProfit` | `Other`
- `estimated_employees`: `1-10` | `11-50` | `51-200` | `201-1000` | `1000+`
- `annual_revenue_range`: `LessThan100k` | `100kTo1M` | `1MTo10M` | `MoreThan10M`
- `source_of_funds`: `Revenue` | `Investment` | `Loans` | `Grants` | `Other`

**Required role:** `admin` or `operator`.

get.description:
Poll the Noah aggregator for the latest KYB verification status and sync it to the local database.

**`kyb_status` values:**
- `pending` — not yet submitted to Noah
- `submitted` — under review
- `approved` — KYB passed; business is verified
- `rejected` — KYB failed; check `reviewer_notes` for the reason
- `expired` — session expired; business must restart the onboarding flow

`profile_exists` distinguishes 'nothing saved yet' from 'saved but not yet submitted' — both report `kyb_status: 'pending'`.

**Required role:** `admin` or `operator`.

post.description:
Fetches the latest status from the document-upload verifier and syncs locally. Use ``GET …/kyb/status`` for the cached status; call this when you need upstream detail after submit.

**Required role:** `admin` or `operator`.

Sends the saved business profile, registered address, and associates to the verifier for final review. **Does not include files** — documents must already be submitted via ``POST …/documents/submit`` and ``POST …/shareholders/documents``.

Mboka auto-builds the upstream ``payload`` from your saved KYB data. Pass ``{ "payload": { ... } }`` only to merge optional overrides.

**Required role:** `admin` or `operator`.

get.description:
Inbound Stellar USDC payments observed on the principal's provisioned accounts by the account-credit watcher. Each item carries the on-chain `tx_hash` and the same `acr_<n>` id used by the `GET /v1/transactions` projection for the same row.

The watcher is flag-off by default (`ACCOUNT_CREDITS_WATCHER_ENABLED=false`) — until it is enabled for this environment **and** Horizon observation is confirmed working, this list stays empty for every account, including ones that received a real on-chain deposit. This is an operational rollout gate, not a sign the deposit was missed; see docs/implementation/ACCOUNT_CREDITS_WATCHER.md.

Fetch a single order by its internal merchant order ID.

Supports authentication via Bearer token (JWT) or API Key (X-API-Key).

Stream live order status updates for a single merchant order.

**Protocol:** WebSocket — use ``ws://`` locally and ``wss://`` in production.

**URL:** ``{base}/api/v1/orders/{merchant_order_id}/status/ws?token={access_token}``

**Auth:** JWT access token in the ``token`` query parameter (not ``Authorization``).
Browser and React Native ``WebSocket`` clients cannot set headers.

**Server messages:** JSON objects matching ``OrderStatusEvent``:

```json
{'type': 'order.status', 'merchant_order_id': 42, 'status': 'processing', 'provider_status': 'pending', 'aggregator_order_id': 'YC-abc', 'updated_at': None}
```

The server sends the current status on connect, pushes again when fields change,
and closes after a terminal status (``completed``, ``failed``, ``refunded``,
``canceled``).

See ``docs/api/ORDER_STATUS_WEBSOCKET.md`` for the frontend integration guide.

post.description: Accepts a pending quote and creates the local merchant order. quote_id is the idempotency key. For Noah OffRamp quotes that returned form_schema on quote, send the completed payment_method in the body. YC and other rails accept with an empty body. OffRamp auto-funds the provider inbox from a ready partner/customer stablecoin account via preview → confirm when available; otherwise returns crypto_deposit payment_instructions for a manual follow-up send. Already accepted quotes return 409 with merchant_order_id when known, expired quotes return 410, and upstream timeouts leave the quote pending so the caller may retry accept.

get.description:
Paginated list of transactions for the authenticated principal.

Supports both **business** principals (Bearer JWT or X-API-Key) and **individual** users (Bearer JWT). Individual users currently see an empty list — orders are scoped to a business in the v1 data model.

Each item carries a `direction` derived from the originating order's type (`in` for OnRamp, `out` for OffRamp). Orders created before direction was recorded return `unknown`.

Also includes inbound Stellar USDC account credits observed by the account-credit watcher, projected with an `acr_<n>` id and `tx_hash` set.

Fetch a single transaction by its internal ID, scoped to the authenticated principal. Accepts either a merchant_order PK (`"7"`) or a projected credit id (`"acr_7"`).

Returns `404` whether the record does not exist or belongs to a different principal — the API does not leak existence across tenants. Individual-user principals always get `404` for order ids until the data model exposes user-owned orders.

- Business: legal_name, registration_number, country, tax_id
- BusinessKybProfile: all KYB-specific fields and associates

All fields are optional at the schema level, but the following are REQUIRED
before you can initiate KYB:
- registration_number, legal_name, country, business_type, registered_address

OrderOut.title: OrderOut
OrderOut.description:
Response schema for a single order — served from local merchant_orders table.

status uses Mboka order statuses: processing, completed, failed,
refunded, canceled, or frozen.

order_type.title: Order Type
order_type.description: Direction. OnRamp = fiat -> crypto. OffRamp = crypto -> fiat.

token.title: Token
token.description: Optional ERC-20 contract address on the target network. When omitted (and ``asset`` is also omitted), defaults to USDT on Polygon (0xc2132d05d31c914a87c6611c10748aeb04b58e8f). A known contract selects that token's currency and network; it is not rewritten to Polygon USDT.

asset.description: Explicit crypto asset (currency, network, optional token). Forwarded as-is for Stellar, EVM, and other rails. When omitted, ``token`` is used; if both are omitted, Polygon USDT is the default.

country.title: Country
country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the fiat rail. Today: 'KE'.

local_amount.title: Local Amount
local_amount.description: Fiat amount. Required for OnRamp. On Stellar OffRamp, may be sent instead of (or with) ``crypto_amount`` to quote in KES.

wallet_address.title: Wallet Address
wallet_address.description: OnRamp only. EVM address where the crypto lands when settled.

source.description: OnRamp only. How the customer pays fiat (e.g. M-PESA number).

recipient.description: OnRamp only. Optional — falls back to KYC profile if omitted. If both payload and KYC are missing required fields, the request returns 422 with the list of missing fields.

crypto_amount.title: Crypto Amount
crypto_amount.description: OffRamp crypto amount. Required for EVM OffRamps. On Stellar OffRamp, provide this or ``local_amount``.

refund_address.title: Refund Address
refund_address.description: OffRamp only. Refund address if the fiat rail fails — EVM ``0x`` or Stellar ``G…`` public key when ``asset.network`` is Stellar.

destination.description: OffRamp fiat payout. Required for EVM OffRamps. Stellar OffRamp may send partner ``payment_method`` instead.

sender.description: OffRamp only. Optional — falls back to KYC profile if omitted. Stellar OffRamp may send partner ``customer`` instead.

payment_method.description: Stellar OffRamp partner payout block (``type``, ``phone_number``, ``network_id``). Ignored for EVM OffRamps, which keep ``destination``.

customer.description: Stellar OffRamp partner customer block (``uid``, ``type``, PII). Ignored for EVM OffRamps, which keep ``sender``.

external_order_id.title: External Order Id
external_order_id.description: Optional. Merchant's own reference for this order. Stored and echoed verbatim in outbound webhooks. No server-side idempotency.

mboka_user_ref.title: Mboka User Ref
mboka_user_ref.description: Optional. Forwarded into client_metadata.mboka_user_ref for merchant-side tracing.

OrderQuoteIn.title: OrderQuoteIn
OrderQuoteIn.description:
Request body for ``POST /v1/orders/quote``.

Single discriminated schema: ``order_type`` selects which subset of fields
is required. See class-level docstring on each field for details, and the
spec at docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-19-elementpay-quote-accept-orders-design.md
for the required/optional matrix per ramp direction.

quote_id.title: Quote Id
quote_id.description: Use as the path param in /accept. Opaque — do not parse.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Aggregator-selected provider. Today: 'yellowcard'. FE should not branch on this.

status.title: Status
status.description: Status for the quote/order lookup. Before an order exists this is the quote lifecycle status; after accept it reflects the provider status from the merchant order.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: When set, the FE MUST disable Accept past this timestamp and re-quote.

form_schema.title: Form Schema
form_schema.description: Noah OffRamp only: dynamic form definition from the aggregator quote. When present, the FE must render the form and send the completed ``payment_method`` on accept. Null for YC and other rails.

PartnerCustomerIn.title: PartnerCustomerIn
PartnerCustomerIn.description: ElementPay partner ``customer`` block for Stellar OffRamp quotes.

type.title: Type
type.description: Rail type. Stellar KE OffRamp uses ``mobile_money``.

network_id.title: Network Id
network_id.description: Provider id from ``GET /supported`` or partner payment-methods.

account_name.title: Account Name
account_name.description: Optional account holder name. Unused on compact Stellar OffRamp wire format.

account_number.title: Account Number
account_number.description: Bank account number when type is bank. Unused for KE M-Pesa.

PartnerPaymentMethodIn.title: PartnerPaymentMethodIn
PartnerPaymentMethodIn.description:
ElementPay partner ``payment_method`` block.

Used on Stellar OffRamp quotes. EVM OffRamps keep ``destination``.

bank_info.title: Bank Info
bank_info.description: When type='bank': provider bank details (accountNumber, bankName, ...).

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: When type='bank': payment reference the customer must include.

wallet_address.title: Wallet Address
wallet_address.description: When type='crypto_deposit': deposit address the user must send crypto to.

memo.title: Memo
memo.description: When type='crypto_deposit': Stellar payment memo/reference, when required.

memo_type.title: Memo Type
memo_type.description: When type='crypto_deposit': memo encoding, usually 'text' for Stellar.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: When type='crypto_deposit': deposit window expiry — render a countdown.

PaymentInstructionsOut.title: PaymentInstructionsOut
PaymentInstructionsOut.description:
Payment instructions returned by /accept.

Discriminated on ``type``:
- ``'momo'`` (OnRamp): ``source`` carries the MoMo source the user pays from.
- ``'crypto_deposit'`` (OffRamp): ``wallet_address`` + ``amount`` + ``currency``
  + ``network`` + ``expires_at`` carry the deposit instructions.

method.title: Method
method.description: Aggregator funding method, e.g. interac, open_banking, momo.

PayoutIn.title: PayoutIn
PayoutIn.description: External bank / Interac / MOMO payout body (partner-passthrough extras allowed).

dob.title: Dob
dob.description: Date of birth in mm/dd/yyyy format.

idNumber.title: Idnumber
idNumber.description: National ID / passport / driver's license number.

additionalIdType.title: Additionalidtype
additionalIdType.description: Nigeria additional ID type for Yellow Card (e.g. bvn, nin). Required when country is NG.

additionalIdNumber.title: Additionalidnumber
additionalIdNumber.description: Nigeria additional ID number (BVN/NIN). Required when country is NG.

PIIBlock.title: PIIBlock
PIIBlock.description:
Recipient (OnRamp) / sender (OffRamp) PII forwarded to the aggregator for KYC.

All fields optional at this layer: if omitted, Mboka resolves the field
from ``user_kyc_profile`` + ``user_identities`` + ``addresses``. If both
payload and KYC are missing a required field, the request fails with 422.

public_url.title: Public Url
public_url.description: Short HTML summary page (not the legal invoice document).

public_pdf_url.title: Public Pdf Url
public_pdf_url.description: Official invoice as PDF (same bytes as authenticated download).

rate.title: Rate
rate.description: Indicative exchange rate at quote time.

rate_currency.title: Rate Currency
rate_currency.description: Currency unit `rate` is expressed in (fiat for OnRamp).

user_pays.description: What the customer commits to send.

fees.title: Fees
fees.description: Provider fee breakdown; keys vary by rail. Display only — never use for math.

amount_currency.title: Amount Currency
amount_currency.description: Currency `amount` is typed in: the source account's currency (amount to debit) or the destination currency (amount to deliver).

available_after_accept.title: Available After Accept
available_after_accept.description: If true, full payment instructions are returned only by /accept (not the quote response).

note.title: Note
note.description: Human-readable preview message for the FE.

QuoteOrderIn.title: QuoteOrderIn
QuoteOrderIn.description: DEPRECATED — stateless pricing preview (replaced by stateful OrderQuoteIn).

reference_delivered.title: Reference Delivered
reference_delivered.description: Whether `reference` reaches the recipient's bank or wallet message.

reference_delivered.title: Reference Delivered
reference_delivered.description: Whether `reference` reaches the recipient's bank or wallet message.

value.title: Value
value.description: Units of `to` received per unit of `from` sent, after fees.

recipient_id.title: Recipient Id
recipient_id.description: Add this route to an existing recipient instead of creating a new one.

account.title: Account
account.description: Account number, mobile number, wallet address or own account id.

details.title: Details
details.description: Extra rail fields some payout methods need (routing number, bank code …).

message.title: Message
message.description: User-facing copy the client can display directly.

field.title: Field
field.description: Request field to mark, when one applies.

message.title: Message
message.description: User-facing explanation the client can show as-is.

SendFailureOut.title: SendFailureOut
SendFailureOut.description: Why a send failed and what the client should offer next.

SendInvoiceIn.title: SendInvoiceIn
SendInvoiceIn.description: Optional overrides; defaults from invoice payload client_* fields.

memo.title: Memo
memo.description: Optional Stellar MEMO_TEXT (≤28 bytes). Ignored on EVM rails.

available.title: Available
available.description: Available balance as a decimal string; null when unknown.

SupportedAccountOut.title: SupportedAccountOut
SupportedAccountOut.description:
One backend-declared local bank rail the dashboard can offer beyond EUR/USD.

See ``app.services.deposit_accounts.supported_rails`` for which rails are
actually listed and why.

SupportIssueIn.title: SupportIssueIn
SupportIssueIn.description: Customer-submitted support issue from the business dashboard.

SupportIssueOut.title: SupportIssueOut
SupportIssueOut.description: Acknowledgement returned after an issue is accepted.

id.title: Id
id.description: Internal merchant order ID, or `acr_<n>` for a projected Stellar USDC account credit.

aggregator_order_id.title: Aggregator Order Id
aggregator_order_id.description: The aggregator-assigned order identifier, once known.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Aggregator / PSP slug (internal routing; UI maps to rail labels).

psp_transaction_id.title: Psp Transaction Id
psp_transaction_id.description: Provider confirmation id (e.g. M-Pesa receipt / bank reference).

payment.description: Fiat counterparty details for receipts when available.

tx_hash.title: Tx Hash
tx_hash.description: On-chain tx hash: the Stellar payment for a projected USDC credit, or for partner orders the customer funding tx (OffRamp) / crypto delivery tx (OnRamp) reported by the aggregator. Null when unknown. Pair with `crypto_network` to build a block-explorer link.

memo.title: Memo
memo.description: On-chain memo for a projected Stellar USDC credit; null for orders.

crypto_network.title: Crypto Network
crypto_network.description: Crypto network, e.g. `BASE`, `POLYGON`, `Stellar` — null when unknown.

financial_account_id.title: Financial Account Id
financial_account_id.description: Owning provider account id for a projected Stellar USDC credit (matches GET /v1/account-credits); null for orders.

source.title: Source
source.description: Row origin signal, e.g. `stellar_payment`, for a projected credit; null for orders.

fee_amount.title: Fee Amount
fee_amount.description: Partner-facing fee when known, forwarded from the aggregator — never computed locally. Sources: ElementPay payout price or upstream `applicable_fee` on account-ledger rows, Circle fee on CCTP, the quoted send fee on stablecoin sends. Charged on top of `amount_fiat` for sends, so the recipient gets the full amount.

fee_currency.title: Fee Currency
fee_currency.description: Currency of `fee_amount` when a fee is present.

fee_status.title: Fee Status
fee_status.description: Fee lifecycle for account-ledger rows, e.g. `final`.

TransactionOut.title: TransactionOut
TransactionOut.description:
Single transaction record.

``direction`` is derived from the persisted ``client_metadata.order_type``
(0 → ``"in"``, 1 → ``"out"``). Orders created before that field was
persisted return ``"unknown"``.

account_name.title: Account Name
account_name.description: Rail account holder when distinct from party_name.

account_number.title: Account Number
account_number.description: Bank account number or mobile-money MSISDN.

network_id.title: Network Id
network_id.description: Provider network id used for routing (internal).

network_name.title: Network Name
network_name.description: Human rail label when known (e.g. M-PESA).

TransactionPaymentOut.title: TransactionPaymentOut
TransactionPaymentOut.description: Fiat-rail counterparty details for receipts and transaction detail.
